dimensions.assessment: Affects entertainment industry entities, employees with access to minors, minor actors, and legal authorities enforcing penalties.
dimensions.evidence: Whoever participates in an entertainment industry project in any position where that individual would have supervisory duties or compulsory authority over any minor

dimensions.assessment: Requires background checks and imposes potentially severe production halts and monetary penalties on entertainment entities for noncompliance.
dimensions.evidence: the Attorney General may seek a civil monetary penalty against that entertainment industry of not more than twice the total amount of the dollar cost of all project production activity

dimensions.assessment: Imposes background check costs of no more than $100 per check on entertainment entities and potential civil monetary penalties.
dimensions.evidence: at the cost of no more than $100 per background check, paid for by the entertainment industry entity.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a federal mandate for background checks and enforcement mechanisms across the entertainment industry.
dimensions.evidence: To mandate a criminal background check, screening only for offenses that involve violence, sex, stalking, or minors

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing, permanent compliance requirements for entertainment industry projects involving minors.
dimensions.evidence: shall be subject to a requirement to successfully pass a criminal background check, within 90 days prior to their first day of work

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates FBI background checks for entertainment industry personnel interacting with minors, sets cost limits, and establishes severe civil penalties and mandatory injunctions halting project production for noncompliance.
